findings.issue: `conjugateLinearEquiv_pullback` writes out `Submodule.span_induction` (generator, zero, add and smul cases) and introduces three identity equivalences `e`, `eS`, `eT` only to restate the same fibres. This re-proves by hand the extension principle Mathlib already provides for linear maps out of exterior powers.

summary: The earlier positional-`@` and repeated-instance problems are fixed, and the two double-conjugation proofs now share one pointwise lemma. The pullback code still has an unexplained `erw`, an unused lemma whose proof depends on definitional unfolding, and a span induction written out by hand.
